item.title: Alpha Reproduction Highlights Thailand's Growing Oil Painting Reproduction Market
item.description: Alpha Reproduction highlighted the expansion of Thailand's oil painting reproduction market, reflecting rising international demand for handcrafted artwork. The announcement outlines industry conditions supporting export-oriented art production, including skilled craftsmanship, structured workflows, and growing global interest in handmade décor solutions.
